rust_summary: A player releases a bow with adjustable charge or cancellation (`native_arrow_loose`).
doc_summary: A player releases a bow: `native_arrow_loose(stack, has_ammo, charge, canceled)` may change held-tick `charge` or cancel the shot; negative charge also prevents it. Unlike `native_living_entity_use_item_stop`, it does not skip the whole item release; `native_entity_shoot_bow` reports the spawned arrow afterward with read-only force. Fires on the Game running the bow release, including LAN guests; a remote client's own release path, crossbows, and ArrowNockEvent are not covered. Bundles need "hooks": @API:arrow_loose@.
